title: Kovee KCP operation registry — K0 frozen (K1 bundles) + K2 slice 1 (governed_work_binding_v1 binding half)

sources.design: DESIGN.md §11.6 (feature bundles) and §11.6.1 (normative authority matrix), with §9.2 as the AuthorizationDependencySet category key
sources.amendment: design/2026-07-25-amendment-governance-owner.md §A5 (wire-name resolution) and §A1 (governance owner retargeting in descriptive text)
sources.revision: k2-1: the governed_work_binding_v1 greenfield-binding rows (governance_enable/show/disable) added for K2 slice 1, extracted from the frozen family-contract §2.A authority row; the k0-2 rows are unchanged (spec/registry-README.md)

a5_note: No A5 wire-name rename applies to the three K1 bundles. K2 slice 1 extracts the greenfield-binding half of governed_work_binding_v1 and applies the A5 renames personal_governed_work_enable/show/disable → governance_enable/show/disable; the bundle's remaining operations (endeavor_promotion_*, byom_episode_binding_show, collaboration_context_bundle_*, workspace_*) are reserved for K2 slice 2 and are NOT in this registry. The bundle is therefore incomplete and is not advertised by hello/protocol_info (§11.6: bundles are atomic). See spec/registry-README.md.
